prompt:
Subject: An aluminum can ready for recycling.

Composition: Show a hand placing an empty clean aluminum beverage can into a collection bin containing similar cans. A simple three-arrow recycling emblem is embossed on the bin, with the can material and open sorting container clearly visible.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep everything inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background. Allow only a plain three-arrow recycling symbol on the collection bin; no lettering or branded symbols. No incidental labels, logos or watermark.
en: A hand places a recyclable aluminum can in a collection bin.
ja: 手が、再生利用できるアルミ缶を回収箱へ入れている。
